_how: Newest first. The dashboard rolls through these, newest at the top. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), where (phone | pc | both | web), title (one line, plain words), body (optional), link (a page on the site, optional), link_label (optional). Commit here — no Netlify build needed. Write it the way you'd say it to a seller, not a developer.
_the_title_is_all_she_sees: ON SCREEN THE DASHBOARD RENDERS ONLY: the Phone/PC pill, the TITLE, the link, and the date. It does NOT render body. And .wn-text is overflow:hidden with an ellipsis on a 1.5-line strip, so a long title is CUT OFF, not wrapped — keep titles under about 50 characters. Body is kept as our own record of what the entry was about; write one short sentence, not a paragraph. Only the newest few are shown (WN_MAX in dashboard.html), so an entry further down the list is invisible until newer ones push past it.
_why_it_is_empty: Cleared 2026-11-12 on Rain's instruction — every entry was from October and the oldest was three weeks stale. An empty items[] is SAFE: dashboard.html returns early on a zero-length list and the whole 'What's new' section stays hidden, so sellers see nothing rather than something old. The next entries are drafted below in _queued and are INVISIBLE to sellers, because only `items` is ever read. Move them into items on the day each one actually ships.

_queued.title: A kept buyer counts when she pays
_queued.body: Mark a keep Paid and it counts toward that seller's quota for the night she bought it, even days later. You no longer need the PC open for it to count.

_queued.title: Your live now says who is selling
_queued.body: If your store has staff on Sweldo, the top bar shows which seller tonight's mines are counting for, and you can tap it to change her mid-live without walking to the kiosk.

_queued.title: Labels that print upside down
_queued.body: There is a switch for it in Printer settings now, and the Test print button obeys it — it did not before, which is why turning it on looked like it did nothing.
